semantics.reference: closed relational first-order AST; explicit finite models are witnesses, never general completeness
semantics.entailment_proofs: asserted sentence, ground unary Horn derivation, or checked unary/binary existential-rule consequence; never a named witness
semantics.identity_template: identical sentence sets over the same signature certify identity model coverage
semantics.event_chain: native four-role/history template plus total injective fresh event renaming; actual endpoint, dependencies, policy and translated query scope hashes checked
semantics.event_guarantee: original history and completed P0 positive support contract; excludes new event identity/count and general first-order inference
semantics.projection: known column projection or set of all values; canonical JSON encoding preserves only its actual input
semantics.absence: diagnostic closed-world policy probe; does not create clinical assertions
semantics.replay: verified supplied inventory and native handler registry; stored bytes alone are not execution or interpretation
semantics.certifier: every certificate carries the native implementation bundle hash (src/med_dsl *.py and *.json raw bytes); reason codes name the unproven side

steps: one at request start; structural, reference, size and hash syntax validation precede execution
reference: each visited formula node and quantifier assignment; each proof candidate; each identity/subset obligation and committed certificate
absence: existing P0 replay charges and one per completed diagnostic row
rename: one per assertion and review and final commit
chain: one per endpoint/scope/history/renaming obligation, existing P0 and native-event evaluation charges, final certificate commit
projection: each row projected and queried, second encoding verification, each scope check and final certificate commit
replay: archive verification, each resource requirement, optional independent semantic-chain charges and final report commit
resource_stop: resource_limit; no partial certificate, probability, bindings or diagnostic report; no semantic loss inferred
evidence: countermodels, checked native templates, completed execution checks and inventory availability remain separately typed
